query:
-- Whether a live repository other than $4, of organization $1 and provider $2, has a place one
-- prune of which would reach into a place of a repository at prefix $3: the same prefix, or one
-- that starts with the other's followed by `workloads/` or `streams/`, where a repository keeps
-- its workloads' backups and offloaded streams (Finding 32 of docs/23-walkthroughs.md). Within
-- an organization a provider name resolves to one installation; across organizations a workload
-- is only ever backed up into its own organization's repositories, under its own identifier, so
-- no prefix chosen in one can reach another's backups.
SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM repository r
     WHERE r.deleted_at IS NULL
       AND r.id <> $4
       AND r.organization_id = $1
       AND r.provider_name = $2
       AND (r.prefix = $3
            OR starts_with($3, r.prefix || 'workloads/')
            OR starts_with(r.prefix, $3 || 'workloads/')
            OR starts_with($3, r.prefix || 'streams/')
            OR starts_with(r.prefix, $3 || 'streams/'))
) AS "overlaps!"
